ExtraInfoLocaKey.text: [Poison:]<poison> Characters take damage equal to their [Poison]<poison> every 2 seconds.
[Crit:]<crit> The percent chance that an auto attack or active ability deals double damage. Each [Crit]<crit> above 100 increases [Crit Damage]<crit> by 1%.
[Burn:]<burn> Characters take damage equal to their [Burn]<burn> each second, then lose one [Burn]<burn>.
[Frost:]<frost> Characters lose [1 Defense]<defense> and [1 Attack Speed]<attackspeed> per [2 Frost]<frost> they have. Every 2 seconds, characters lose [1 Frost]<frost>.
[Stall (X):]<stall> Activates after X seconds have elapsed in combat.
[Rush (X):]<rush> Triggers at the start of combat and expires after X seconds.
[Shards:]<shard> The currency used to purchase upgrades from the shop.
<sprite name=Omnivamp> [Omnivamp:]<omnivamp> Restores Health to a character based on the damage they deal. [1 Omnivamp]<omnivamp> = 1% healing from damage dealt.
<sprite name=Rank> [Rank:]<rank> Heroes gain stats and unlock additional abilities as they gain [Ranks]<rank>. Purchasing an additional copy of a Hero from the shop increases their [Rank]<rank>.
[Stealth:]<stealth> A character with [Stealth]<stealth> can not be targeted by enemies.
[Shield:]<shield> Damage is removed from a character's [Shields]<shield> before their [Health]<health>. [Shields]<shield> last 10 seconds unless otherwise specified.
[Debuff:]<debuff> [Poison]<poison>, [Frost]<frost>, and [Burn]<burn> are [Debuffs]<debuff>.
[Stun:]<stun> A [Stunned]<stun> character cannot move or act. When [Stunned,]<stun> Heroes gain stacking 25% [Stun Resistance]<bold> for 15 seconds.
[Taunt:]<taunt> A [Taunted]<taunt> character changes their target to the enemy who [Taunted]<taunt> them.
[Reroll:]<reroll> Players can pay [Shards]<shard> to [reroll]<reroll> to shop, displaying new Heroes, items, and relics.

[Basic Stats:]<basicstat> [Attack]<attack>, [Max HP]<maxhealth>, [Defense]<defense>, [Crit]<crit>, [Attack Speed]<attackspeed>, [Mana Regen]<manaregen>, and [Magic]<magic> are [basic stats]<basicstat>.
[Reserves:]<reserve> Heroes the player owns but are not in combat are kept in the [Reserves]<reserve>. Their abilities marked with [Backup]<backup> can still trigger.
[Generate:]<generate> A [Shard]<shard> is [generated]<generate> whenever it is created by an ability, item, or relic.
[Backup:]<backup> Abilities with [Backup]<backup> also work while the Hero is in the [Reserves]<reserve>.
Niklas's [Red Hot Deals]<bold> generates [Shards]<shard> equal to 80% of an item's value in the shop. Common = [4 Shards]<shard>, Rare = [12 Shards]<shard>, Epic = [20 Shards]<shard>.
Fiona's [The Right Hand]<bold> creates rarer items as Fiona's [rank]<rank> increases. [Rank B]<bold> = Common, [Rank A]<bold> = Rare, [Rank S]<bold> = Epic.
Niklas's [Wheel and Deal]<bold> creates rarer items as his [rank]<rank> increases. [Rank B]<bold> = Common, [Rank A]<bold> = Rare,  [Rank S]<bold> = Epic.

[Emergency Rewind]<bold> protects you from defeat while collecting [Shards]<shard> as you win combats. It collects [5 Shards]<shard> per combat victory. It is used when a combat is lost, giving you all of the [Shards]<shard> that were accumulated. If you lose another combat while [Emergency Rewind]<bold> is unavailable, your run will end in defeat.

Grace's [The Benevolent]<bold> permanently gives Heroes the following [primary stats]<primarystat> for each of their [classes]<class>:

[Assassin:]<assassin> [7 Crit]<crit>
[Duelist:]<duelist> [10 Attack Speed]<attackspeed>
[Mage:]<mage> [12 Magic]<magic>
[Mystic:]<mystic> [2 Mana Regen]<manaregen>
[Tank:]<tank> [15 Defense]<defense>
[Vanguard:]<vanguard> [100 Max HP]<maxhp>
[Warrior:]<warrior> [12 Attack]<attack>
[Lasting:]<lasting> [Shields]<shield> with [lasting]<lasting> do not expire over time. [Shields]<shield> normally expire after 10 seconds.
[Backup Only:]<backuponly> Abilities with [Backup Only]<backuponly> only work while the Hero is in the [Reserves]<reserve>.
[The Rift Storm]<storm> begins after 50 seconds of combat and deals increasing amounts of damage each second.
[Backup Only:]<backuponly> Abilities with [Backup Only]<backuponly> only work while the Hero is in the [Reserves]<reserve>.

1.name: Frontline
1.title: Sporty
1.description: They believe the only way to close the rifts is to overpower them, and they've turned that conviction into a performance brand. Teams train and compete like athletes, chasing a personal best with every break.

2.name: The Hunt
2.title: Street
2.tagline: When the call comes, we hunt.
2.description: A guild of Awakened professionals built for the chase, first through the door and closing in before a rift can breach do real damage. They hunt to win: the monster, the trophy, and the reputation that follows.

3.name: L'Héritage
3.title: Luxury
3.description: A prestige guild that recruits two kinds of breakers: heirs to old money, and rising stars famous enough to be worth the investment. It trains elite, media-ready breakers and moves easily through the circles where wealth, fame, and power overlap.

4.name: A Temple
4.title: Punk
4.description: A guild that believes the Shards & relics locked inside the rifts belongs to everyone, not to whoever can buy the rights to it. They fight to put those treasures in the hands of ordinary people.

5.name: Gaia Project
5.title: Bohemian
5.tagline: Fight for tomorrow, not just today.
5.description: A community-driven guild that treats the rifts as living phenomena to be understood. Its breakers study each one closely and work to restore the natural balance around it, often staying long after the fighting is done.

6.name: Aegis Global
6.title: Corporate
6.description: A corporate guild that has built a global network spanning crystal refinement, relic acquisition, and rift forecasting. It contracts its breakers to keep supply chains moving and rift activity contained.

lore.subtitle: They said I'd never do this again.
lore.currentGuild: A champion athlete, until a shoulder injury ended her career. Her powers awakened soon after, healing her - but making her too strong to fairly compete against ordinary people. Frontline signed her soon after. The performance guild built an entire marketing campaign around her: a champion everyone wrote off, coming back stronger than ever. In the rifts she's known for her ambition and explosive power.
lore.motivation: A new guild is a clean track: real stakes, a team that needs her to perform rather than pose.

lore.subtitle: Everything is lining up.
lore.currentGuild: Even by a marksman's standard he's reliable to a degree that's rare, and no one can trace where he learned it: no paper trail, no prior guild, no training on record. He keeps to himself, says only what needs saying, and the shot lines up every time. He's covering a younger brother's tuition; once it's paid, he may leave the way he arrived.
lore.motivation: A smaller guild means less time waiting at the back of a big raid and more contracts he can actually close. More contracts, more rank, more money. The math isn't complicated.

lore.subtitle: If I'm in, we train hard. Let's get to work.
lore.currentGuild: Frontline brought her in as a trainer, and she's one of the best they've had: Junior breakers come out of her sessions looking like fighters. What drives her: a pitch for a sanctioned tournament for Awakened, opponents finally worth the trouble.
lore.motivation: Two honest questions. Will you train as hard as she does? And will your guild back her tournament when it's time? Yes and yes, and she's in.

lore.subtitle: I will not let our guild down.
lore.currentGuild: She marks the dangerous targets, opens angles for everyone else, and takes her own mistakes personally. The Hunt values her reliability and has made peace with how little she reveals about herself.
lore.motivation: She needs a guild that holds itself to a certain standard, and a team worth the loyalty. One caveat: no one has seen her without the mask, and knows who she really is.

lore.subtitle: It's okay. You can take a peek.
lore.currentGuild: The old stories say you shouldn't look a gorgon in the eye. Zuri built a career on the opposite: everyone looks. Cameras, sponsors, monsters - her gaze stops them all where they stand, some more literally than others. L'Héritage trained her for both audiences, and she's never once blinked first.
lore.motivation: Convince her your guild won't be overlooked, and she's interested.

lore.subtitle: I've brought them with me.
lore.currentGuild: A famous singer years before her Awakening. When her powers grew, her voice swelled, a choir rose with it. She still performs, and takes rift contracts between tours; letting her power loose in a rift is the one thing that quiets the choir.
lore.motivation: The voices grow restless between fights. She's looking for a guild that keeps them singing.

lore.subtitle: Yeah. I know I'm small. Get over it.
lore.currentGuild: Nyx slipped past three rift lockdowns before The Hunt gave up chasing the kid and signed them instead. Now the youngest breaker on any roster: too quick to catch, too vicious to ignore. Nyx has no family on file, no address, no home. They don't trust The Hunt enough to sleep at their guild house. But every time there's a fight, the kid is always already there.
lore.motivation: Nyx doesn't follow guilds but people worth trusting - and hasn't found one yet. Be the first, and the kid stops being a stray.

lore.subtitle: Ohh.. can you smell that? This rift is alive.
lore.currentGuild: Nobody at Gaia is entirely sure where she came from. She turned up at their second meeting and never left, because her strange ideas about rifts kept turning out to be right. Her senses run stronger than anyone's: colors carry meaning, music has flavor, and a rift sings to her in a structure only she can hear. Gaia treats her as something between a daughter and a researcher.
lore.motivation: She'll never fully leave Gaia, but she's drawn to a guild that takes on plenty of contracts. Just know she may wander off mid-contract.

lore.subtitle: Looks like you know a deal when you see one.
lore.currentGuild: He's who Aegis sends when something has to move quietly: officially an acquisitions lead, unofficially their smuggler-in-chief. Self-made, and long decided that fairness is a luxury for people who can afford to lose. Nothing leaves a rift in his presence without a cut for him.
lore.motivation: Aegis pays well, but it watches everything and owns everything he touches. A new guild is an open market: fewer eyes, a bigger margin, first pick of whatever comes out of a rift before it's logged. He's switching if he believes you're the better deal.

lore.subtitle: I've got all we need here with me.
lore.currentGuild: She fixed toasters and bicycles at a neighborhood repair café before her Awakening gave her the rare gift of fusing artifacts inside a rift, fusing gear like no other breaker can. She's Niklas's right hand across Aegis's supply chain: he acquires, she combines. No one's figured out how artifacts actually work, but her goal is to build them from scratch.
lore.motivation: A guild with the resources to keep her workshop stocked and the sense not to disturb her while she works.

lore.subtitle: You're safe with me.
lore.currentGuild: He's the wall the rest of the team forms up behind. Rowan spent six years mining crystals out of rifts for a mining company. The more crystals they took, the more the rifts started acting strange. He couldn't prove mining was the cause, but he believed it. Gaia was the first to say out loud what his gut already knew: take less, listen more.
lore.motivation: Nobody ever truly leaves the Gaia community behind, but Rowan would join any guild that has a chance to end the crisis and cares about consequences. He'll know within a day whether yours does.

lore.subtitle: Let them try. I'll take it gladly.
lore.currentGuild: An eye for an eye - except Skorn takes two; Hit him and get hit back. He's built his whole fighting style around one insane conviction: nothing in any rift can take more pain than he can. So far, nothing has. Every scar is a fight where the monster blinked first.
lore.motivation: He gets bored in guilds that fight carefully. Promise him the front of every fight, and the ugliest opponents you can find, and he's in.

lore.subtitle: I don't fight for sport. I fight to end this.
lore.currentGuild: Logan survived a rift that got all members of his previous team killed. Since then he fights with one goal: end every fight as fast as possible. No showing off, no wasted moves, no casualties. Frontline loves marketing its stars - Logan gives them nothing to work with, and doesn't care.
lore.motivation: He believes the big guilds gain too much from the Rift crisis to ever end it. Prove your guild actually wants to finish it, and he's all in.

lore.subtitle: Let me do things my way.
lore.currentGuild: Funke's flames were never meant to be carried inside one body. He ended raids alone and took half the site with him. The incident reports stopped distinguishing between "victory" and "collateral" years ago. A Temple is the only guild that can work with him at all, and even that takes everything he has to hold back. Sometimes he goes quiet mid-thought, like he's listening to something else.
lore.motivation: Every guild so far has wanted him smaller, contained. Be the first to ask what happens when he stops holding back, and he'll show you personally.

lore.subtitle: Oh.. I might actually be brilliant at this.
lore.currentGuild: Tilly looks like the sweetest thing L'Héritage ever put in front of a camera - right up until the flails start spinning. What follows is fast, heavy, and disturbingly cheerful. L'Héritage adores the contrast on camera. Off camera, even her coaches keep a respectful distance.
lore.motivation: She's not interested in being L'Héritage's new shiny thing. Her idea of beauty is a monster coming apart mid-swing. A guild with the bloodiest contracts is a guild she'll love.

lore.subtitle: I've been wanting to test a scenario like this.
lore.currentGuild: He came up through academia, with three published papers before he turned twenty one, and Aegis hired him straight out of his post-doc. He runs the numbers behind crystal refining, making each batch yield more usable energy than the last, and his models are why Aegis's supply chain has stayed a step ahead of every competitor for six straight quarters.
lore.motivation: He wants a new challenge. Yours presents an interesting scenario. He'd like to see how it plays out.

lore.subtitle: Are you sure your guild can afford me?
lore.currentGuild: Ratna works in public relations for L'Héritage, smoothing over disasters and getting government support and favorable extraction rights signed. The chairman takes her calls when he won't take anyone else's. She works a rift the same way she works a room: watching who's in it, who's worth knowing, what it needs from her next.
lore.motivation: You don't recruit Ratna. You earn her attention, and then she lends your guild her influence.

lore.subtitle: Woof woof, no need to be scared. I don't bite.
lore.currentGuild: He's a frontliner with a reputation for tearing the heart out of whatever he kills, a habit left over from his old job on a cleanup crew hauling monster carcasses. He Awakened mid-shift; A Temple was the only guild that showed up to recruit him. Behind the mask he's entirely sane. Most teammates need time to work that out.
lore.motivation: Point him towards fresh meat and he'll join your slaughterhouse gladly. Your recruiter gets about thirty seconds to do so.

lore.subtitle: I'm not here to talk.
lore.currentGuild: She's a frost duelist: patient, exact, and the one who actually finishes the fights everyone else in the punk guild loves starting. She came over from Aegis Global, Dragomir's department officially, and whatever she walked away with isn't on any record. A Temple offered her a contract on the spot.
lore.motivation: She doesn't think the big, official guilds will ever end this crisis. If your guild does things differently, she'll listen.

lore.subtitle: So this is where the world sends me next.
lore.currentGuild: He's a frontliner with a particular kind of fire: solid, dependable, quiet in the briefing. Ming owns what fits in one bag and has never needed more. Guilds kept offering him a career path; he kept politely losing the paperwork. The Hunt is lenient enough to keep him on anyway - knowing full well that one morning, his bag will be gone.
lore.motivation: Ming lives in the moment, and it takes something real to grab his attention. There's something in how you lead that he can't quite let drift past.

lore.subtitle: If they want you, they'll have to go through me.
lore.currentGuild: She's the guardian who plants herself in front of her people to protect them. The poison spreads from her, buying everyone the time they need. She met Sal on the Gaia forum, trading notes, and after six months of bickering they noticed they were writing love letters. Their shared goal, once the crisis ends: a cottage with a rose garden.
lore.motivation: She and Sal want one thing answered: does your guild have a real chance of ending this? Gaia takes fewer contracts than the big names, and at this rate the cottage stays a long way off. Gaia is family, so they'll never fully leave. But move the clock forward, and they're with you.

lore.subtitle: See? We're still here.
lore.currentGuild: She has always been keeping small things since she was a child: pressed flowers, faded photographs, small acts of preservation. Her Awakening carries the same instinct: frost that can shatter but also preserve, depending what's needed. It's the same frost that slows the poison in Pimenta's veins.
lore.motivation: She goes where Pimenta goes. Bring the day closer when none of this is needed anymore, and she'll work twice as hard to get there.

lore.subtitle: You'll want me here. Trust me.
lore.currentGuild: Dragomir's Awakening nearly killed him. Look closely and you could argue it partly did. Yet every year since, he's looked a little more vibrant, a little more alive; his doctors stopped trying to offer explanations long ago. He's well-spoken, with an old-world courtesy that puts people at ease and keeps anyone from investigating his condition too closely.
lore.motivation: Aegis is starting to ask questions. A new guild means new faces and answers he won't have to give for years.

lore.subtitle: Don't have all the fun without me.
lore.currentGuild: One of the guild's shotcallers. He leads on charm more than rank, and keeps the team together when a fight turns. He made his name soloing a guardian before his squad could catch up, and he's been pushing past what the playbook recommends ever since.
lore.motivation: The Hunt does steady work, and steady bores him. Yours looks like the one that won't play it safe.

lore.subtitle: Me? Really? I.. I'll try my best.
lore.currentGuild: The bookish one in a family of athletes, Grace never expected to end up in a rift. Then her awakened powers turned up a rare healing affinity, and the Department of Guild Affairs fielded her before she'd decided if she wanted it. Frightened before every fight, frightened after every one, and back again for the next anyway. It's exactly the story Frontline's self-improvement campaigns are built to tell.
lore.motivation: Give her the confidence she's missing. Believe in her, and she becomes the backbone of your team.

1001.name: The Void Beast
1001.title: The Void Beast
1001.text: An ancient being materializes in front of your guild. It hungers not for flesh or Shards, but memories. It conjures 3 long-lost relics before your guild, and offers them in exchange for a bite of remembrance.
1001.crossroadsDescription: Gain a rare relic for a price.

choices.title: Trade
choices.text: Gain {name}. Your Heroes start next combat [Stunned]<stun> for {time} seconds.
choices.outcome: A deal was struck. The Void Beast hands your guild the relic, reaches into their minds, then disappears. Your Heroes feel strange, but they aren't sure why.

choices.title: Refuse
choices.text: Your Heroes gain [+{statbonus}% basic stats]<basicstat> next combat.
choices.outcome: "We're fine, thanks, Mr. Void Beast."

1006.name: The Curse of the Kiss
1006.title: The Curse of the Kiss
1006.text:
Your guild wanders upon an ornate stone temple. The door to the temple is blocked by the weathered statue of a strange monster. The statue's true form has been lost to time, but its wide mouth and squat frame vaguely resemble that of a frog.

The statue whispers something into the minds of your Heroes, not in language they recognize but in a wave of pure intention. "Kiss me. Free me."
1006.crossroadsDescription: Gain relics or items for a price.

choices.title: Peck Cheek
choices.text: Gain {name}. All Heroes permanently lose {amount} {stat}.
choices.outcome: One by one, your Heroes walk up to the statue and give it a peck on the cheek. Mere seconds after {hero} gives the final kiss, a wave of unease washes over your Heroes and the statue begins to crumble into dust. With the door unblocked your Heroes wander into the temple.

choices.title: Kiss Lips
choices.text: Gain {name}. A Hero permanently loses {amount} {stat}.
choices.outcome: {hero} steps up to the statue and plants a kiss on its lips. They feel a piece of their heart fade away into the statue, and watch as the statue slowly crumbles into dust. With the door unblocked your Heroes wander into the temple.

choices.title: Kiss Forehead
choices.text: Choose a B-rank or higher Hero. Randomly retrain their B-Rank Specialization into another one. Get a rare item.
choices.outcome: {hero} steps up to the statue and plants a kiss on its forehead. They sense a change deep within, and watch as the statue slowly crumbles into dust. With the door unblocked your Heroes wander into the temple.

1013.name: The Guild Banner
1013.title: The Guild Banner
1013.text: Your guild catches a break between fights. Talk drifts to the guild's banner, which needs a design to be submitted to The Department of Guild Affairs by tomorrow. Each Hero has their own opinion on which design they should choose for the banner.
1013.crossroadsDescription: Craft a banner for your guild.

choices.title: {name} Design
choices.text: Gain a {name} relic.
choices.outcome: Your guild decorated their banner with a {class}-themed design. They also overcame their greatest challenge yet: a pile of paperwork.

choices.title: {name} Design
choices.text: Gain a {name} relic.
choices.outcome: Your guild decorated their banner with a {class}-themed design. They also overcame their greatest challenge yet: a pile of paperwork.

1014.name: Crystalline Prison
1014.title: Crystalline Prison
1014.text: The path ahead is blocked by a large monster encased in crystal up to its neck. The crystals are draining its power, and it seems to take all of the monster's remaining energy to pry open a single eye to gaze sadly upon your Heroes. It seems harmless, and could use your help.
1014.crossroadsDescription: Retrain a Hero, or strengthen Heroes over time.

choices.title: Ignore
choices.text: Choose a Hero. Retrain one of their upgrades.
choices.outcome: As one of the heroes passes, a crystal brushes against their leg. Its power is changing something inside the Hero.

choices.title: Free (Growth)
choices.text: Gain a {name}.
choices.outcome: Your Heroes work away at the crystalline prison with their mining tools until the monster is free. It lacks the strength to thank your guild, but gestures towards a nearby {name} with its eyes.

choices.title: Free (Surge)
choices.text: Gain a {name}.
choices.outcome: Your Heroes work away at the crystalline prison with their mining tools until the monster is free. It lacks the strength to thank your guild, but gestures towards a nearby {name} with its eyes.

1017.name: The Slumbering Monster
1017.title: The Slumbering Monster
1017.text: A giant beast snores away peacefully atop a hoard of precious items it has collected over the eons. Its nostrils bellow smoke with each exhale.
1017.crossroadsDescription: Gain an item. Rarer items Burn your Heroes next combat.

choices.title: Bold
choices.text: Gain {name}. At the start of next combat, your Heroes receive [Burn]<burn> equal to [{burnpercent}% of their Max HP]<maxhp>.
choices.outcome: Your Heroes woke the monster while grabbing its treasure. It bellowed flames from its mouth in anger, but your Heroes were able to run before getting too badly burnt.

choices.title: Safe
choices.text: Gain {name}.
choices.outcome: Your Heroes safely grabbed the item and escaped without waking the monster.

1018.name: The Nest
1018.title: The Nest
1018.text: A single egg, big as a barrel, rests in a nest of bones. Something glints inside the shell - an artifact, half-grown into its surface. The mother is nowhere in sight, but it can't be far.
1018.crossroadsDescription: Wait for a common relic, or take a rarer one at a cost.

choices.title: Defend
choices.text: Choose from {reliccount} common relics. Get the relic after winning {combatcount} combat.
choices.outcome: Your guild defends the egg from nearby predators. The mother returns to her nest and recognizes your guild's good deed. She regurgitates an artifact from deep within her belly, covered in sticky green goo. Your guild will need some time to wash it off before they can use it.

choices.title: Steal
choices.text: Gain {name}. Your Heroes have [-{defensepenalty}% Defense]<defense> next combat.
choices.outcome: Your guild lifts the egg and slips away. Somewhere behind, something starts to track you.

1019.name: Strange Fruits
1019.title: Strange Fruits
1019.text: Your guild wanders into a large grove of colorful, alien fruits. Upon closer inspection, the fruits are warm to the touch and radiate large amounts of magical energy.
1019.crossroadsDescription: Gain immediate or future power, for a price.

choices.title: Blue Fruits
choices.text: Choose 1 of {reliccount} rare relics. Each is paired with a strange fruit relic that reduces a stat for all Heroes.
choices.outcome: Each of your Heroes bites into a strange blue fruit. They taste like nostalgia and garlic.

choices.title: Red Fruits
choices.text: Choose 1 of {reliccount} relics which each increase a stat for all Heroes. Your Heroes start next combat [stunned]<stun> for {stuntime} seconds.
choices.outcome: Each of your Heroes bites into a strange red fruit. They taste like anxiety and grapes.

choices.title: Yellow Fruits
choices.text: For the next {stuncombatcount} combats your Heroes start combat [stunned]<stun> for {stunduration} seconds. After those {stuncombatcount} combats, your Heroes permanently gain [{maxhpbonus} Max HP]<maxhp>.
choices.outcome: Each of your Heroes bites into a strange yellow fruit. They taste like uncertainty and lemons.

1022.name: The Reflecting Pool
1022.title: The Reflecting Pool
1022.text: Your Heroes stumble upon a whisper-still pool of bright blue water in a glade. As they gaze into it, its perfectly mirrored surface begins to ripple and swirl with reflections of the past. An object shimmers at the water's surface.
1022.crossroadsDescription: Gain special relics and items for your most-played classes.

1023.name: Express Delivery
1023.title: Blessing of Hermes
1023.text: A figure in a dark uniform skids out of a portal, parcel tucked under one arm. He lands beside your guild, already producing a clipboard.

1024.name: The Ringing Fall
1024.title: The Ringing Fall
1024.text: A majestic waterfall appears before your guild. A high-pitched ringing sound pierces through the crashing water every 15 seconds like clockwork. It seems to be coming from behind the waterfall.
1024.crossroadsDescription: Rank up a Hero at a price, or strengthen one later.

1025.name: The Etched Path
1025.title: The Cartograph
1025.text: Your guild decides to investigate a crumbling ruin. Inside, they find an ancient map carved directly into its walls. It points to treasures in four different directions.
1025.crossroadsDescription: Get relics or items in the future.

1026.name: The Rift Puppy
1026.title: The Rift Puppy
1026.text: An adorable rift puppy is surrounded by hungry beasts. It pleads for help with beady, sad eyes.
1026.crossroadsDescription: Gain Shards in the future, or gain an item for a cost.

1027.name: Three Paths
1027.title: The Jagged Divide
1027.text: A three-way fork in the road. To the left, a quiet meadow. To the middle, a chasm split with jagged pillars. To the right, a dark forest of bone-white trees.
1027.crossroadsDescription: Gain stats, or choose to fight stronger enemies for future rewards.

1028.name: The Fairy Ring
1028.title: The Fairy Ring
1028.text: Your guild spots a ring of pulsing mushrooms in a clearing, each one as big as a bear. Spores roll off them in slow green waves. At the center, a slim rift hovers above a pile of treasures.
1028.crossroadsDescription: Gain an item, or gain an epic item or relic at a cost.

1029.name: The Well of Temptations
1029.title: The Well of Temptations
1029.text: Your Heroes find themselves drawn towards the edge of an old well, the stone worn smooth by age. The water below seems tempting; the deeper they look, the brighter it shines.

1030.name: The Debtor
1030.title: The Debtor
1030.text: A faceless creature drifts towards your guild. It draws a scroll from its sleeve and unfurls it to reveal a mess of swirling, inky, alien runes. The runes thoughtfully re-arrange themselves into symbols your Heroes can recognize: "I have relic, if you have shard."
1030.crossroadsDescription: Choose from relics of increasing rarity for a price.

1031.name: The Three Urns
1031.title: The Three Urns
1031.text: Your guild discovers a mausoleum. Once inside, they notice a reliquary with three open urns sitting atop it. As your guild approaches the urns, they slam shut and shuffle themselves, as though guided by the hand of some far-off swindler.
1031.crossroadsDescription: Gamble for a relic, Shards, or a curse.

1032.name: Trial: Single Combat
1032.title: Trial: Single Combat
1032.text: Your guild crests a hill and notices an energy field containing a single monster waiting in the valley below, standing triumphantly over a pile of treasure.
1032.crossroadsDescription:
Choose a single Hero to battle against an enemy for a variety of rewards.

There are no penalties for death or defeat in trial combats.

1033.name: Trial: Endurance
1033.title: Trial: Endurance
1033.text: Your guild turns a corner and notices an energy field surrounding a small army of mushroom monsters. They are guarding a pile of Shards, and seem to be surrounded by an impenetrable shield.
1033.crossroadsDescription:
Survive as long as possible against immortal enemies to earn Shards.

There are no penalties for death or defeat in trial combats.

1034.name: Trial: Demolition
1034.title: Trial: Demolition
1034.text: Your guild spots an energy field surrounding a single armored turtle. It's protecting a pile of Shards. It doesn't seem very threatening, but its shell looks incredibly sturdy.
1034.crossroadsDescription:
Quickly defeat a durable enemy to earn Shards.

There are no penalties for death or defeat in trial combats.

1035.name: Trial: Rematch
1035.title: Trial: Rematch
1035.text:
Your guild discovers a massive creature standing inside a canyon. Even from afar they can clearly recognize the very same {bossname} they defeated not long ago!
There are sizzling runes etched around it in a circle.
1035.crossroadsDescription:
Defeat the Act 1 Boss with a challenging twist to earn a rare relic.

There are no penalties for death or defeat in trial combats.

1036.name: Rest
1036.title: Rest
1036.text: Your guild finds a secluded location to rest and recover before the next fight.
1036.crossroadsDescription: Heroes gain +{statbonus}% basic stats next combat.

Events.Event_1001.EventDescription.en: An ancient being materializes in front of your guild. It hungers not for flesh or Shards, but memories. It conjures 3 long-lost relics before your guild, and offers them in exchange for a bite of remembrance.

Events.Event_1006.Choice_1.ChoiceOutcome.en: One by one, your Heroes walk up to the statue and give it a peck on the cheek. Events.Event_1006.Choice_1.ChoiceText.fr: Obtenez {name}. Tous les Héros perdent définitivement {amount} {stat}.

Events.Event_1006.Choice_2.ChoiceOutcome.en: {hero} steps up to the statue and plants a kiss on its lips. They feel a piece of their heart fade away into the statue, and watch as the statue slowly crumbles into dust. With the door unblocked your Heroes wander into the temple.
Events.Event_1006.Choice_2.ChoiceOutcome.fr: {hero} s'approche de la statue et dépose un baiser sur ses lèvres. Sentant un fragment de son cœur se dissiper dans la pierre, votre Héros regarde la statue tomber lentement en poussière. La porte étant dégagée, vos Héros pénètrent dans le temple.

Events.Event_1006.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Obtenez des reliques ou des objets en payant le prix.

Events.Event_1006.EventDescription.en:
Your guild wanders upon an ornate stone temple. The door to the temple is blocked by the weathered statue of a strange monster. The statue's true form has been lost to time, but its wide mouth and squat frame vaguely resemble that of a frog.

The statue whispers something into the minds of your Heroes, not in language they recognize but in a wave of pure intention. "Kiss me. Free me."
Events.Event_1006.EventDescription.fr:
Votre guilde tombe sur un temple de pierre richement orné. La porte du sanctuaire est bloquée par la statue érodée d'un monstre étrange. Sa forme originelle s'est perdue dans les âges, mais sa large bouche et sa silhouette trapue rappellent vaguement celles d'une grenouille.

La statue murmure dans l'esprit de vos Héros, non pas avec des mots connus, mais par une onde de pure intention : « Embrassez-moi. Libérez-moi. »

Events.Event_1013.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Confectionnez une bannière pour votre guilde.

Events.Event_1013.EventDescription.en: Your guild catches a break between fights. Talk drifts to the guild's banner, which needs a design to be submitted to The Department of Guild Affairs by tomorrow. Each Hero has their own opinion on which design they should choose for the banner.
Events.Event_1013.EventDescription.fr: Votre guilde profite d'une accalmie entre deux combats. La discussion dérive sur la bannière de la guilde, dont le motif doit être soumis au Département des Affaires de Guilde d'ici demain. Chaque Héros a son propre avis sur le motif à adopter.

Events.Event_1014.Choice_1.ChoiceOutcome.en: As one of the heroes passes, a crystal brushes against their leg. Its power is changing something inside the Hero.
Events.Event_1014.Choice_1.ChoiceOutcome.fr: Alors qu'un des Héros passe à proximité, un cristal lui effleure la jambe. Son pouvoir transforme quelque chose au plus profond du Héros.

Events.Event_1014.Choice_1.ChoiceText.en: Choose a Hero. Retrain one of their upgrades.
Events.Event_1014.Choice_1.ChoiceText.fr: Choisissez un Héros. Réinitialisez l'une de ses améliorations.

Events.Event_1014.Choice_2.ChoiceOutcome.en: Your Heroes work away at the crystalline prison with their mining tools until the monster is free. It lacks the strength to thank your guild, but gestures towards a nearby {name} with its eyes.
Events.Event_1014.Choice_2.ChoiceOutcome.fr: Vos Héros s'acharnent sur la prison cristalline avec leurs outils de minage jusqu'à libérer le monstre. Trop affaibli pour remercier votre guilde, il désigne du regard un(e) {name} à proximité.

Events.Event_1014.Choice_3.ChoiceOutcome.en: Your Heroes work away at the crystalline prison with their mining tools until the monster is free. It lacks the strength to thank your guild, but gestures towards a nearby {name} with its eyes.
Events.Event_1014.Choice_3.ChoiceOutcome.fr: Vos Héros s'acharnent sur la prison cristalline avec leurs outils de minage jusqu'à libérer le monstre. Trop affaibli pour remercier votre guilde, il désigne du regard un(e) {name} à proximité.

Events.Event_1014.CrossroadsDescription.en: Retrain a Hero, or strengthen Heroes over time.
Events.Event_1014.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Réentraînez un Héros, ou renforcez vos Héros sur la durée.

Events.Event_1014.EventDescription.en: The path ahead is blocked by a large monster encased in crystal up to its neck. The crystals are draining its power, and it seems to take all of the monster's remaining energy to pry open a single eye to gaze sadly upon your Heroes. It seems harmless, and could use your help.
Events.Event_1014.EventDescription.fr: Le chemin est bloqué par un imposant monstre prisonnier du cristal jusqu'au cou. Les cristaux drainent son énergie, et le monstre semble puiser dans ses toutes dernières forces pour entrouvrir un œil et poser un regard triste sur vos Héros. Il paraît inoffensif et aurait bien besoin de votre aide.

Events.Event_1017.Choice_1.ChoiceOutcome.en: Your Heroes woke the monster while grabbing its treasure. It bellowed flames from its mouth in anger, but your Heroes were able to run before getting too badly burnt.
Events.Event_1017.Choice_1.ChoiceOutcome.fr: Vos Héros ont réveillé le monstre en s'emparant de son trésor. Furieux, il a craché un torrent de flammes, mais vos Héros ont réussi à s'enfuir avant d'être trop gravement brûlés.

Events.Event_1017.Choice_1.ChoiceText.en: Gain {name}. At the start of next combat, your Heroes receive [Burn]<burn> equal to [{burnpercent}% of their Max HP]<maxhp>.
Events.Event_1017.Choice_1.ChoiceText.fr: Obtenez {name}. Au début du prochain combat, vos Héros subissent une [Brûlure]<burn> égale à [{burnpercent}% de leurs PV Max]<maxhp>.

Events.Event_1017.Choice_2.ChoiceOutcome.en: Your Heroes safely grabbed the item and escaped without waking the monster.
Events.Event_1017.Choice_2.ChoiceOutcome.fr: Vos Héros se sont emparés de l'objet en douceur et se sont éclipsés sans réveiller le monstre.

Events.Event_1017.CrossroadsDescription.en: Gain an item. Rarer items Burn your Heroes next combat.
Events.Event_1017.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Obtenez un objet. Les objets plus rares infligent Brûlure à vos Héros lors du prochain combat.

Events.Event_1017.EventDescription.en: A giant beast snores away peacefully atop a hoard of precious items it has collected over the eons. Its nostrils bellow smoke with each exhale.
Events.Event_1017.EventDescription.fr: Une bête gigantesque ronfle paisiblement au sommet d'un trésor d'objets précieux amassés au fil des éons. Ses narines crachent de la fumée à chaque expiration.

Events.Event_1018.Choice_1.ChoiceOutcome.en: Your guild defends the egg from nearby predators. The mother returns to her nest and recognizes your guild's good deed. She regurgitates an artifact from deep within her belly, covered in sticky green goo. Your guild will need some time to wash it off before they can use it.
Events.Event_1018.Choice_1.ChoiceOutcome.fr: Votre guilde défend l'œuf contre les prédateurs rôdant aux alentours. La mère regagne son nid et reconnaît la bonne action de votre guilde. Elle régurgite du fond de ses entrailles un artéfact recouvert d'une bave verte gluante. Votre guilde aura besoin d'un peu de temps pour le nettoyer avant de pouvoir s'en servir.

Events.Event_1018.Choice_1.ChoiceText.en: Choose from {reliccount} common relics. Get the relic after winning {combatcount} combat.
Events.Event_1018.Choice_1.ChoiceText.fr: Choisissez parmi {reliccount} reliques communes. Obtenez la relique après avoir remporté {combatcount} combat.

Events.Event_1018.Choice_2.ChoiceOutcome.en: Your guild lifts the egg and slips away. Somewhere behind, something starts to track you.
Events.Event_1018.Choice_2.ChoiceOutcome.fr: Votre guilde soulève l'œuf et file en douce. Quelque part derrière vous, quelque chose se met en chasse.

Events.Event_1018.Choice_2.ChoiceText.en: Gain {name}. Your Heroes have [-{defensepenalty}% Defense]<defense> next combat.
Events.Event_1018.Choice_2.ChoiceText.fr: Obtenez {name}. Vos Héros ont [-{defensepenalty}% de Défense]<defense> lors du prochain combat.

Events.Event_1018.CrossroadsDescription.en: Wait for a common relic, or take a rarer one at a cost.
Events.Event_1018.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Patientez pour obtenir une relique commune, ou prenez-en une plus rare en payant le prix.

Events.Event_1018.EventDescription.en: A single egg, big as a barrel, rests in a nest of bones. Something glints inside the shell - an artifact, half-grown into its surface. The mother is nowhere in sight, but it can't be far.
Events.Event_1018.EventDescription.fr: Un œuf solitaire, gros comme un tonneau, repose dans un nid d'ossements. Quelque chose scintille dans la coquille : un artéfact à moitié incrusté dans sa surface. La mère n'est pas en vue, mais elle ne doit pas être bien loin.

Events.Event_1019.Choice_1.ChoiceOutcome.en: Each of your Heroes bites into a strange blue fruit. They taste like nostalgia and garlic.
Events.Event_1019.Choice_1.ChoiceOutcome.fr: Chacun de vos Héros croque dans un étrange fruit bleu. Il a un goût de nostalgie et d'ail.

Events.Event_1019.Choice_1.ChoiceText.en: Choose 1 of {reliccount} rare relics. Each is paired with a strange fruit relic that reduces a stat for all Heroes.
Events.Event_1019.Choice_1.ChoiceText.fr: Choisissez 1 relique rare parmi {reliccount}. Chacune est associée à une relique de fruit étrange qui réduit une statistique pour tous les Héros.

Events.Event_1019.Choice_2.ChoiceOutcome.en: Each of your Heroes bites into a strange red fruit. They taste like anxiety and grapes.
Events.Event_1019.Choice_2.ChoiceOutcome.fr: Chacun de vos Héros croque dans un étrange fruit rouge. Il a un goût d'anxiété et de raisin.

Events.Event_1019.Choice_2.ChoiceText.en: Choose 1 of {reliccount} relics which each increase a stat for all Heroes. Your Heroes start next combat [stunned]<stun> for {stuntime} seconds.
Events.Event_1019.Choice_2.ChoiceText.fr: Choisissez 1 relique parmi {reliccount} augmentant chacune une statistique pour tous les Héros. Vos Héros commencent le prochain combat [Étourdis]<stun> pendant {stuntime} secondes.

Events.Event_1019.Choice_3.ChoiceOutcome.en: Each of your Heroes bites into a strange yellow fruit. They taste like uncertainty and lemons.
Events.Event_1019.Choice_3.ChoiceOutcome.fr: Chacun de vos Héros croque dans un étrange fruit jaune. Il a un goût d'incertitude et de citron.

Events.Event_1019.Choice_3.ChoiceText.en: For the next {stuncombatcount} combats your Heroes start combat [stunned]<stun> for {stunduration} seconds. After those {stuncombatcount} combats, your Heroes permanently gain [{maxhpbonus} Max HP]<maxhp>.
Events.Event_1019.Choice_3.ChoiceText.fr: Lors des {stuncombatcount} prochains combats, vos Héros commencent le combat [Étourdis]<stun> pendant {stunduration} secondes. Après ces {stuncombatcount} combats, vos Héros gagnent définitivement [{maxhpbonus} PV Max]<maxhp>.

Events.Event_1019.CrossroadsDescription.en: Gain immediate or future power, for a price.
Events.Event_1019.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Gagnez en puissance immédiatement ou plus tard, en payant le prix.

Events.Event_1019.EventDescription.en: Your guild wanders into a large grove of colorful, alien fruits. Upon closer inspection, the fruits are warm to the touch and radiate large amounts of magical energy.
Events.Event_1019.EventDescription.fr: Votre guilde s'aventure dans un vaste bosquet d'arbres aux fruits exotiques et colorés. En les examinant de plus près, les fruits sont chauds au toucher et dégagent une intense énergie magique.

Events.Event_1022.CrossroadsDescription.en: Gain special relics and items for your most-played classes.
Events.Event_1022.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Obtenez des reliques et objets spéciaux pour vos classes les plus jouées.

Events.Event_1022.EventDescription.en: Your Heroes stumble upon a whisper-still pool of bright blue water in a glade. As they gaze into it, its perfectly mirrored surface begins to ripple and swirl with reflections of the past. An object shimmers at the water's surface.
Events.Event_1022.EventDescription.fr: Vos Héros tombent sur un bassin d'eau d'un bleu éclatant, parfaitement immobile au cœur d'une clairière. Tandis qu'ils le contemplent, sa surface miroitante se met à onduler et à tourbillonner de reflets du passé. Un objet miroite à la surface de l'eau.

Events.Event_1023.EventDescription.en: A figure in a dark uniform skids out of a portal, parcel tucked under one arm. He lands beside your guild, already producing a clipboard.
Events.Event_1023.EventDescription.fr: Une silhouette en uniforme sombre dérape hors d'un portail, un colis coincé sous le bras. Il atterrit aux côtés de votre guilde en sortant déjà son porte-bloc.

Events.Event_1024.CrossroadsDescription.en: Rank up a Hero at a price, or strengthen one later.
Events.Event_1024.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Promouvez un Héros en payant le prix, ou renforcez-en un plus tard.

Events.Event_1024.EventDescription.en: A majestic waterfall appears before your guild. A high-pitched ringing sound pierces through the crashing water every 15 seconds like clockwork. It seems to be coming from behind the waterfall.
Events.Event_1024.EventDescription.fr: Une cascade majestueuse se dresse devant votre guilde. Un tintement aigu perce le fracas de l'eau toutes les 15 secondes avec la régularité d'un métronome. Il semble provenir de derrière le rideau d'eau.

Events.Event_1025.CrossroadsDescription.en: Get relics or items in the future.
Events.Event_1025.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Obtenez des reliques ou des objets plus tard.

Events.Event_1025.EventDescription.en: Your guild decides to investigate a crumbling ruin. Inside, they find an ancient map carved directly into its walls. It points to treasures in four different directions.
Events.Event_1025.EventDescription.fr: Votre guilde décide d'explorer des ruines croulantes. À l'intérieur, elle découvre une carte ancienne gravée à même les murs, indiquant des trésors dans quatre directions différentes.

Events.Event_1026.CrossroadsDescription.en: Gain Shards in the future, or gain an item for a cost.
Events.Event_1026.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Gagnez des Éclats plus tard, ou obtenez un objet en payant le prix.

Events.Event_1026.EventDescription.en: An adorable rift puppy is surrounded by hungry beasts. It pleads for help with beady, sad eyes.
Events.Event_1026.EventDescription.fr: Un adorable chiot de la faille est encerclé par des bêtes affamées. Il implore votre aide de ses petits yeux tristes.

Events.Event_1027.CrossroadsDescription.en: Gain stats, or choose to fight stronger enemies for future rewards.
Events.Event_1027.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Gagnez des statistiques, ou choisissez d'affronter des ennemis plus redoutables contre de futures récompenses.

Events.Event_1027.EventDescription.en: A three-way fork in the road. To the left, a quiet meadow. To the middle, a chasm split with jagged pillars. To the right, a dark forest of bone-white trees.
Events.Event_1027.EventDescription.fr: Une bifurcation à trois voies. À gauche, une prairie paisible. Au centre, un gouffre hérissé de piliers déchiquetés. À droite, une forêt sombre aux arbres blancs comme l'os.

Events.Event_1028.CrossroadsDescription.en: Gain an item, or gain an epic item or relic at a cost.
Events.Event_1028.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Obtenez un objet, ou obtenez un objet épique ou une relique en payant le prix.

Events.Event_1028.EventDescription.en: Your guild spots a ring of pulsing mushrooms in a clearing, each one as big as a bear. Spores roll off them in slow green waves. At the center, a slim rift hovers above a pile of treasures.
Events.Event_1028.EventDescription.fr: Votre guilde repère dans une clairière un cercle de champignons palpitants, chacun aussi gros qu'un ours. Des spores s'en échappent en lentes vagues verdâtres. Au centre, une fine faille flotte au-dessus d'un amas de trésors.

Events.Event_1029.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Tentez votre chance pour obtenir des récompenses de plus en plus puissantes.

Events.Event_1029.EventDescription.en: Your Heroes find themselves drawn towards the edge of an old well, the stone worn smooth by age. The water below seems tempting; the deeper they look, the brighter it shines.
Events.Event_1029.EventDescription.fr: Vos Héros se sentent attirés vers la margelle d'un vieux puits dont la pierre a été polie par le temps. L'eau au fond paraît tentante : plus ils plongent le regard, plus elle brille intensément.

Events.Event_1030.CrossroadsDescription.en: Choose from relics of increasing rarity for a price.
Events.Event_1030.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Choisissez parmi des reliques de rareté croissante en payant le prix.

Events.Event_1030.EventDescription.en: A faceless creature drifts towards your guild. It draws a scroll from its sleeve and unfurls it to reveal a mess of swirling, inky, alien runes. The runes thoughtfully re-arrange themselves into symbols your Heroes can recognize: "I have relic, if you have shard."
Events.Event_1030.EventDescription.fr: Une créature sans visage flotte vers votre guilde. Elle tire un parchemin de sa manche et le déroule, révélant un enchevêtrement de runes d'encre extraterrestres. Les runes se réorganisent d'elles-mêmes pour former des symboles que vos Héros peuvent lire : « J'ai relique, si vous avez éclat. »

Events.Event_1031.CrossroadsDescription.en: Gamble for a relic, Shards, or a curse.
Events.Event_1031.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Tentez votre chance pour obtenir une relique, des Éclats ou une malédiction.

Events.Event_1031.EventDescription.en: Your guild discovers a mausoleum. Once inside, they notice a reliquary with three open urns sitting atop it. As your guild approaches the urns, they slam shut and shuffle themselves, as though guided by the hand of some far-off swindler.
Events.Event_1031.EventDescription.fr: Votre guilde découvre un mausolée. À l'intérieur, elle remarque un reliquaire surmonté de trois urnes ouvertes. Dès que votre guilde s'en approche, les urnes se referment d'un coup sec et se mélangent toutes seules, comme manipulées par la main d'un escroc invisible.

Events.Event_1032.CrossroadsDescription.en:
Choose a single Hero to battle against an enemy for a variety of rewards.

There are no penalties for death or defeat in trial combats.
Events.Event_1032.CrossroadsDescription.fr:
Choisissez un seul Héros pour affronter un ennemi en duel et remporter diverses récompenses.

Il n'y a aucune pénalité en cas de mort ou de défaite lors des combats d'épreuve.

Events.Event_1032.EventDescription.en: Your guild crests a hill and notices an energy field containing a single monster waiting in the valley below, standing triumphantly over a pile of treasure.
Events.Event_1032.EventDescription.fr: Votre guilde franchit la crête d'une colline et aperçoit un champ d'énergie renfermant un unique monstre qui attend dans la vallée en contrebas, dressé triomphalement sur un tas de trésors.

Events.Event_1033.CrossroadsDescription.en:
Survive as long as possible against immortal enemies to earn Shards.

There are no penalties for death or defeat in trial combats.
Events.Event_1033.CrossroadsDescription.fr:
Survivez le plus longtemps possible face à des ennemis immortels pour gagner des Éclats.

Il n'y a aucune pénalité en cas de mort ou de défaite lors des combats d'épreuve.

Events.Event_1033.EventDescription.en: Your guild turns a corner and notices an energy field surrounding a small army of mushroom monsters. They are guarding a pile of Shards, and seem to be surrounded by an impenetrable shield.
Events.Event_1033.EventDescription.fr: Au détour d'un chemin, votre guilde aperçoit un champ d'énergie entourant une petite armée de monstres-champignons. Ils gardent un tas d'Éclats et semblent protégés par un bouclier impénétrable.

Events.Event_1034.CrossroadsDescription.en:
Quickly defeat a durable enemy to earn Shards.

There are no penalties for death or defeat in trial combats.
Events.Event_1034.CrossroadsDescription.fr:
Terrassez rapidement un ennemi coriace pour gagner des Éclats.

Il n'y a aucune pénalité en cas de mort ou de défaite lors des combats d'épreuve.

Events.Event_1034.EventDescription.en: Your guild spots an energy field surrounding a single armored turtle. It's protecting a pile of Shards. It doesn't seem very threatening, but its shell looks incredibly sturdy.
Events.Event_1034.EventDescription.fr: Votre guilde repère un champ d'énergie entourant une tortue cuirassée solitaire qui protège un tas d'Éclats. Elle n'a pas l'air très menaçante, mais sa carapace semble incroyablement robuste.

Events.Event_1035.CrossroadsDescription.en:
Defeat the Act 1 Boss with a challenging twist to earn a rare relic.

There are no penalties for death or defeat in trial combats.
Events.Event_1035.CrossroadsDescription.fr:
Terrassez le Boss de l'Acte 1 avec un handicap corsé pour remporter une relique rare.

Il n'y a aucune pénalité en cas de mort ou de défaite lors des combats d'épreuve.

Events.Event_1035.EventDescription.en:
Your guild discovers a massive creature standing inside a canyon. Even from afar they can clearly recognize the very same {bossname} they defeated not long ago!
There are sizzling runes etched around it in a circle.
Events.Event_1035.EventDescription.fr:
Votre guilde découvre une créature colossale au fond d'un canyon. Même de loin, vos Héros reconnaissent sans peine le même {bossname} qu'ils ont vaincu il y a peu !
Des runes grésillantes sont gravées en cercle tout autour de lui.

Events.Event_1036.CrossroadsDescription.en: Heroes gain +{statbonus}% basic stats next combat.
Events.Event_1036.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Les Héros gagnent +{statbonus}% de stats de base lors du prochain combat.

Events.Event_1036.EventDescription.en: Your guild finds a secluded location to rest and recover before the next fight.
Events.Event_1036.EventDescription.fr: Votre guilde trouve un endroit isolé pour se reposer et récupérer avant le prochain combat.

Events.Event_2000.Choice_1.ChoiceText.en: Increase your endless mode score by 1.
Events.Event_2000.Choice_1.ChoiceText.fr: Augmente votre score en Mode Infini de 1.

Events.Event_2000.CrossroadsDescription.en: Increase your endless mode score by 1.
Events.Event_2000.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Augmente votre score en Mode Infini de 1.

Events.Event_2000.EventDescription.en: Increase your endless mode score by 1.
Events.Event_2000.EventDescription.fr: Augmente votre score en Mode Infini de 1.

Events.Event_2004.Choice_1.ChoiceText.en: Choose a Hero. Retrain one of their upgrades.
Events.Event_2004.Choice_1.ChoiceText.fr: Choisissez un Héros. Réinitialisez l'une de ses améliorations.

Events.Event_2004.CrossroadsDescription.en: Retrain an upgrade on one of your Heroes.
Events.Event_2004.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Réinitialisez une amélioration sur l'un de vos Héros.

Events.Event_2004.EventDescription.en: Retrain an upgrade on one of your Heroes.
Events.Event_2004.EventDescription.fr: Réinitialisez une amélioration sur l'un de vos Héros.

Events.Event_2005.CrossroadsDescription.en: Permanently increase a Hero's Max HP by {amount}.
Events.Event_2005.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Augmente définitivement les PV Max d'un Héros de {amount}.

Events.Event_2006.CrossroadsDescription.en: Permanently increase a Hero's Mana Regen by {amount}.
Events.Event_2006.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Augmente définitivement la Régén. Mana d'un Héros de {amount}.

Events.Event_2007.CrossroadsDescription.en: Permanently increase a Hero's Attack by {amount}.
Events.Event_2007.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Augmente définitivement l'Attaque d'un Héros de {amount}.

Events.Event_2008.CrossroadsDescription.en: Permanently increase a Hero's Magic by {amount}.
Events.Event_2008.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Augmente définitivement la Magie d'un Héros de {amount}.

Events.Event_2009.CrossroadsDescription.en: Permanently increase a Hero's Defense by {amount}.
Events.Event_2009.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Augmente définitivement la Défense d'un Héros de {amount}.

Events.Event_2010.CrossroadsDescription.en: Permanently increase a Hero's Attack Speed by {amount}.
Events.Event_2010.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Augmente définitivement la Vitesse d'Attaque d'un Héros de {amount}.

Events.Event_2011.CrossroadsDescription.en: Permanently increase a Hero's Crit by {amount}.
Events.Event_2011.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Augmente définitivement le Critique d'un Héros de {amount}.

Events.Event_2012.CrossroadsDescription.en: Get an S-Rank Hero from one of your most-played classes.
Events.Event_2012.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Recrutez un Héros de rang S appartenant à l'une de vos classes les plus jouées.

Events.Event_2012.EventDescription.en: Get a random S-Rank Hero from one of your 3 most-played classes.
Events.Event_2012.EventDescription.fr: Recrutez un Héros de rang S aléatoire appartenant à l'une de vos 3 classes les plus jouées.

Events.Event_2013.CrossroadsDescription.en: Permanently increase a Hero's Omnivamp by {amount}.
Events.Event_2013.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Augmente définitivement l'Omnivamp d'un Héros de {amount}.

Events.Event_2014.CrossroadsDescription.en: Permanently increase a Hero's HP/S by {amount}.
Events.Event_2014.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Augmente définitivement les PV/s d'un Héros de {amount}.

Events.Event_503.CrossroadsDescription.en: Get a special item or relic with offensive properties.
Events.Event_503.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Obtenez un objet spécial ou une relique aux propriétés offensives.

Events.Event_503.EventDescription.en: A stone altar, mostly reclaimed by moss. Something gleams at its base.
Events.Event_503.EventDescription.fr: Un autel de pierre, presque entièrement envahi par la mousse. Quelque chose luit à sa base.

Events.Event_504.CrossroadsDescription.en: Get a special item or relic with defensive properties.
Events.Event_504.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Obtenez un objet spécial ou une relique aux propriétés défensives.

Events.Event_504.EventDescription.en: A long-dead beast lies sprawled across the path, swallowed by vines. Its armor is still intact.
Events.Event_504.EventDescription.fr: Une bête morte depuis longtemps gît en travers du chemin, engloutie par les lianes. Son armure est encore intacte.

Events.Event_505.CrossroadsDescription.en: Get a special item or relic which pays off in the future.
Events.Event_505.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Obtenez un objet spécial ou une relique qui portera ses fruits plus tard.

Events.Event_505.EventDescription.en: A camp left behind by an unsuccessful guild, abandoned in a hurry. They didn't die here, but they did leave something useful behind.
Events.Event_505.EventDescription.fr: Un campement abandonné à la hâte par une guilde malchanceuse. Ses membres n'ont pas péri ici, mais ils ont laissé quelque chose d'utile derrière eux.

Events.Event_506.CrossroadsDescription.en: A gift for your newly-formed guild.
Events.Event_506.CrossroadsDescription.fr: Un cadeau pour votre guilde fraîchement formée.

Events.Event_506.EventDescription.en: A clerk from the Department of Guild Affairs leans through the rift's threshold, parcel in hand. She waves your guild over and hands them the parcel before vanishing back to the other side.
Events.Event_506.EventDescription.fr: Une employée du Département des Affaires de Guilde se penche à travers le seuil de la faille, un colis à la main. Elle fait signe à votre guilde d'approcher et lui remet le paquet avant de disparaître de l'autre côté.

Events.Event_600.Choice_1.ChoiceText.en: Rank up a {rank}-rank or lower Hero.
Events.Event_600.Choice_1.ChoiceText.fr: Promouvoir un Héros de rang {rank} ou inférieur.

Events.Event_600.Choice_2.ChoiceText.en: Choose a Hero. Retrain one of their upgrades.
Events.Event_600.Choice_2.ChoiceText.fr: Choisissez un Héros. Réinitialisez l'une de ses améliorations.

Events.Event_600.Choice_4.ChoiceOutcomeT.en: Your guild settles in for a proper rest and wake up the morning more refreshed than usual.
Events.Event_600.Choice_4.ChoiceOutcomeT.fr: Votre guilde s'installe pour un repos bien mérité et se réveille au matin plus revigorée que jamais.

Events.Event_600.Choice_4.ChoiceText.en: Your Heroes gain [+{statbonus}% basic stats]<basicstat> next combat.
Events.Event_600.Choice_4.ChoiceText.fr: Vos Héros gagnent [+{statbonus}% de stats de base]<basicstat> lors du prochain combat.

Events.Event_600.Choice_5.ChoiceOutcomeT.fr: Votre guilde reprend la route sans tarder.

Events.Event_600.EventDescription.en: Your guild gathers around the campfire, and your Heroes enjoy a rare moment of calm.

HeroClasses.HeroClass_1.Description.en:
[Warriors]<warrior> use [Attack]<attack> to deal damage with auto attacks and active abilities.

[Warrior Mechanics]<warrior>: [Crit]<crit>, [Rush]<rush>, [Shields]<shield>.
HeroClasses.HeroClass_1.Description.fr:
Les [Guerriers]<warrior> utilisent l'[Attaque]<attack> pour infliger des dégâts avec leurs attaques auto et compétences actives.

[Mécaniques de Guerrier]<warrior> : [Critique]<crit>, [Assaut]<rush>, [Boucliers]<shield>.

HeroClasses.HeroClass_2.Description.en:
[Tanks]<tank> use [Defense]<defense> to protect their allies and disrupt enemies.

[Tank Mechanics:]<tank> [Stall]<stall>, [Poison]<poison>, [Frost]<frost>.
HeroClasses.HeroClass_2.Description.fr:
Les [Tanks]<tank> utilisent la [Défense]<defense> pour protéger leurs alliés et perturber les ennemis.

[Mécaniques de Tank :]<tank> [Tempo]<stall>, [Poison]<poison>, [Gel]<frost>.

HeroClasses.HeroClass_3.Description.en:
[Vanguards]<vanguard> use [Max HP]<maxhp> to absorb and dish out damage.

[Vanguard Mechanics:]<vanguard> [Rush]<rush>, [Shields]<shield>, [Burn]<burn>.
HeroClasses.HeroClass_3.Description.fr:
Les [Avant-gardes]<vanguard> utilisent les [PV Max]<maxhp> pour encaisser et infliger des dégâts.

[Mécaniques d'Avant-garde :]<vanguard> [Assaut]<rush>, [Boucliers]<shield>, [Brûlure]<burn>.

HeroClasses.HeroClass_4.Description.en:
[Assassins]<assassin> use [Crit]<crit> to deal bursts of damage with their auto attacks and active abilities.

[Assassin Mechanics:]<assassin> [Crit]<crit>, [Shards]<shard>, [Poison]<poison>, [Rush]<rush>, [Stealth]<stealth>.
HeroClasses.HeroClass_4.Description.fr:
Les [Assassins]<assassin> utilisent le [Critique]<crit> pour infliger des rafales de dégâts avec leurs attaques auto et compétences actives.

[Mécaniques d'Assassin :]<assassin> [Critique]<crit>, [Éclats]<shard>, [Poison]<poison>, [Assaut]<rush>, [Camouflage]<stealth>.

HeroClasses.HeroClass_5.Description.en:
[Duelists]<duelist> use [Attack Speed]<attackspeed> to rapidly auto attack.

[Duelist Mechanics:]<duelist> [Stall]<stall>, [Rush]<rush>, [Debuffs]<debuff>, [Crit]<crit>, [Shards]<shard>.
HeroClasses.HeroClass_5.Description.fr:
Les [Duellistes]<duelist> utilisent la [Vitesse d'Attaque]<attackspeed> pour enchaîner rapidement les attaques auto.

[Mécaniques de Duelliste :]<duelist> [Tempo]<stall>, [Assaut]<rush>, [Malus]<debuff>, [Critique]<crit>, [Éclats]<shard>.

HeroClasses.HeroClass_6.Description.en:
[Mystics]<mystic> use [Mana Regen]<manaregen> to repeatedly cast their active ability, aiding allies and disrupting enemies.

[Mystic Mechanics:]<mystic> [Shields]<shield>, [Shards]<shard>, [Debuffs]<debuff>, [Stall]<stall>.
HeroClasses.HeroClass_6.Description.fr:
Les [Mystiques]<mystic> utilisent la [Régén. Mana]<manaregen> pour lancer fréquemment leur compétence active, aidant les alliés et perturbant les ennemis.

[Mécaniques de Mystique :]<mystic> [Boucliers]<shield>, [Éclats]<shard>, [Malus]<debuff>, [Tempo]<stall>.

HeroClasses.HeroClass_7.Description.en:
[Mages]<mage> use [Magic]<magic> to deal damage and disrupt enemies with their active abilities.

[Mage Mechanics:]<mage> [Stall]<stall>, [Burn]<burn>, [Frost]<frost>.
HeroClasses.HeroClass_7.Description.fr:
Les [Mages]<mage> utilisent la [Magie]<magic> pour infliger des dégâts et perturber les ennemis avec leurs compétences actives.

[Mécaniques de Mage :]<mage> [Tempo]<stall>, [Brûlure]<burn>, [Gel]<frost>.
